entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You're speaking with Diana at VeloFit. How can I help you today?
Oh, hi. Yes. I think I need to return something? I got this jersey but... it's just the wrong size. I'm a bit confused about how this all works.
I can certainly help you with that. Just to be clear, is it a technical fault with the item or more of a preference issue with the fit?
It's the fit. It feels way too tight. The website was a little overwhelming, and I must have picked the wrong one. I wanted to do an exchange, but I couldn't figure it out. Can't you just help me?
Of course, I can help sort this out. Let me just pull up your order. Could I get your full name and order number, please?
Yes, it's Sam Jones. Order number is VF-1138-22. I think.
Thank you, Sam. One moment... Okay, I see your order for the Ascend Series jersey, delivered 14 days ago. I just need to check our return eligibility.
Oh, 14 days... is that okay? I feel like I read so many different policies online, I got lost.
Not a problem at all. Our policy for a standard item like this jersey allows for returns within 90 days of delivery, so you are well within the timeframe.
Oh, really? That's a relief! So I can send it back?
Absolutely. Since you mentioned the jersey was just too tight, would you prefer a simple return for a refund, or would you like me to process an exchange for the next size up?
An exchange would be perfect! I love the color, it was just the wrong size.

Excellent. I have processed that exchange for you. I'm sending an email to you right now with a pre-paid return label. Just print that out, package the original jersey, and drop it in the mail. We'll send out the new size as soon as the return is scanned by the carrier.
Wow, that was so easy. Thank you so much for your help, Diana.
You are very welcome, Sam. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Great. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
